case.title: Design: the no-match messages say No matrices match and No category matches
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Type zzz in the search.
  3. Open Settings › Categories.
  4. Type zzz in the search.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The list area shows a search icon and reads "No matrices match "zzz"" with no period, and a Clear Search button, as in picture 6.10.

Step 3:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 4:

  • The list area reads "No category matches "zzz"" with no period, and a Clear Search button, as in picture 7.6.
